name: Absorption
summary: This EA trades based on the 'Absorption' candlestick pattern, where a candle's body engulfs the previous candle's body, signaling a potential reversal. It enters trades in the direction of the absorbing candle after the pattern is confirmed. The strategy applies fixed lot sizing without martingale or grid components.
summary_zh: 该EA基于'吸收'K线形态进行交易，当一根K线的实体完全包住前一根K线的实体时，视为潜在反转信号。形态确认后，沿吸收K线方向开仓。策略采用固定手数，无马丁格尔或网格成分。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是经典的吸收（吞没）K线形态识别，即当前K线的实体完全覆盖前一根K线的实体，判断为市场力量反转信号。入场条件为：阳线吞没阴线时做多，阴线吞没阳线时做空，形态在K线收盘确认后触发交易。出场条件依赖止损和止盈参数的设定，若未设置则可能无明确退出机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，不做动态调整或加仓。资金管理方面没有基于账户余额或风险的动态计算，存在单笔风险不可控的问题。整体策略逻辑简单直观，但缺乏过滤条件和多重确认，容易在震荡行情中产生虚假信号导致频繁亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on identifying the classic Absorption (Engulfing) candlestick pattern, where the current candle's body completely covers the previous candle's body, signaling a potential market reversal. Entry conditions are: a bullish candle engulfing a bearish candle triggers a buy, while a bearish candle engulfing a bullish candle triggers a sell, with trades executed after the pattern is confirmed at candle close. Exit conditions rely on user-configured stop loss and take profit parameters; if these are not set, there may be no explicit exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment or position scaling. Money management lacks risk-based or account-equity-based dynamic calculation, creating uncontrolled per-trade risk exposure. The overall logic is straightforward but lacks filtering conditions and multi-confirmation, making it prone to false signals and frequent losses in ranging markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
基于经典K线形态，有广泛的技术分析理论支撑
无马丁格尔或网格机制，不会因连续亏损而爆仓
代码结构简洁，便于二次开发和优化
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
Based on a classic candlestick pattern with broad technical analysis support
No martingale or grid mechanism, avoiding account blow-up from consecutive losses
Clean code structure, convenient for further development and optimization
cons: 单一K线形态缺乏过滤机制，震荡行情中假信号多
默认止损止盈为0，未设置时风险极大
固定手数不随账户资金动态调整，资金管理粗糙
没有新K线检查机制，可能同一根K线上重复开仓
缺乏趋势过滤、成交量确认等辅助条件
cons_en: Single candlestick pattern lacks filtering, generating many false signals in ranging markets
Default stop loss and take profit are 0, creating extreme risk when not configured
Fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment based on account equity is crude money management
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
Lacks auxiliary conditions such as trend filtering or volume confirmation
improvements: 增加趋势方向过滤（如均线方向），只在顺势方向交易吸收形态
加入基于ATR的动态止损止盈，替代固定点数或零值默认
实现风险百分比仓位计算，根据账户余额动态调整手数
添加新K线检查和持仓检查，防止重复开仓
improvements_en: Add trend direction filtering (e.g., moving average direction) to trade absorption patterns only in the trend direction
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit instead of fixed values or zero defaults
Implement risk-percentage position sizing that dynamically adjusts lot size based on account equity
Add new bar check and position check to prevent duplicate entries

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，不设置则无任何退出保护
无新K线检查，可能在一根K线上反复开仓导致仓位失控
无持仓检查，可能叠加多个同方向订单放大风险
单一形态无过滤，震荡市中可能连续触发亏损交易
risk_points_en: Default stop loss and take profit are 0, providing no exit protection if not configured
No new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same bar, leading to uncontrolled exposure
No position check may stack multiple same-direction orders, amplifying risk
Single pattern without filtering can trigger consecutive losing trades in ranging markets
